recipe.visualDefinition: A weathered, cyan-toned landscape featuring a low horizon line with a silhouetted vehicle, framed by a heavy, distressed dark border with film-burn and chemical-stain effects. The central focus is a large, stylized retro-modern wordmark with a textured fill.
coreVisualRelationships: The large central text anchors the vast negative space of the sky.
The dark, grungy border contrasts with the bright, hazy cyan sky.
The low-placed vehicle silhouette provides a sense of scale and movement against the static horizon.
coreInvariants: Heavy distressed border with irregular, organic edges.
Monochromatic cyan/teal color palette with high-contrast black and white accents.
Layered textures including scratches, dust, and paper grain across the entire surface.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary wordmark is centered horizontally and vertically; the secondary subject (truck) is small and positioned in the lower right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central text, move down to the subtitle, then follow the horizon line to the truck on the right, finally circling the distressed border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive open sky area in the upper two-thirds, creating a sense of distance and atmosphere.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the center sky, transitioning to deep shadows at the edges; saturation is muted to mimic vintage film processing.

letterConstructionRules: Continuous stroke connecting letters where possible
Lowercase-style 'a' and 'g' but scaled to display height
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' or first letter features a sweeping, integrated underline or tail that connects to the following glyphs.
Letters like 'g' and 'd' have closed, circular counters.

treatment.outline: Double stroke: thin dark inner, thick dark outer glow

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed on a semi-transparent horizontal bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, fluid custom script paired with a rigid, wide-tracked industrial sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Semi-transparent white horizontal bar behind subtitle
Heavy vignette/border with chemical burn textures

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric, tubular feel of the main logo.
Matches the blocky, wide-tracked aesthetic of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cyan-tinted landscape with a low horizon line under a vast, hazy sky. In the bottom right corner, include a dark silhouette of a pickup truck. Apply a heavy, distressed black border with organic, messy edges resembling old film or chemical stains. Add layers of dust, scratches, and film grain across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered wordmark in a heavy, rounded, connected script style. The text should have a textured off-white fill and a dark outer glow. Below it, add a subtitle in a wide-tracked, all-caps blocky sans-serif font, placed on a thin, semi-transparent white horizontal band.

verificationChecks: Is the sky color a consistent cyan/teal tint?
Is the border sufficiently distressed and irregular?
Does the main text have a thick, rounded, connected appearance?
Is the truck silhouette positioned low on the horizon?

adjustableVariables: Amount of surface grit and scratches
mustRedesign: Exact letter-to-letter connections of the original wordmark
Specific photographic details of the truck

mustAchieve: Sense of vastness and open road

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the texture.
Check that the border doesn't obscure the central text.
Verify the cyanotype-like color grading is uniform.
Confirm the subtitle bar is semi-transparent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cyanotype landscape + Distressed film border + Heavy rounded connected display type + Wide-tracked blocky subtitle.
